correctness.rationale: The cut graph is a union of alternating paths (including isolated vertices), or an even alternating cycle. A deficient path has both ends in the query set S. If the path is proper, making its S-vertices positive and all other queried vertices negative blocks both boundary edges; there are too few internal vertices outside S to match the positives. A spanning deficient path instead gives exactly one 11 edge, no 00 edge, odd order 2m+1, and m+1 positives. To realize a proper trace in this case, remove any omitted positive in the linear alternating path and match consecutive pairs on each of the even-length remnants; keep only the edges covering the desired trace. The full trace uses the exceptional edge and consecutive pairs among the remaining vertices, also valid for n=3. Minimum odd-cycle covers are exactly these supports, since at size m+1 the complement is independent of size m and exactly one edge has both ends in S. The crossing-matching bound and these explicit supports give the VC dimension. For the adaptive bound, one zero root branch gives the matching-coverage class of P_(n-1). The generic bipartite block-matrix representation is valid: complementary left coordinates encode omitted identity columns, and the needed minor is nonzero exactly when a matching monomial exists. The prior basis-class equality is sound; independently, its dimension is d=r_2(E)-r(E), where r_2 is the union rank of two copies: the largest basis difference is shattered by extending each prescribed positive subset away from its prescribed negatives, and any shattered set is contained in a basis difference. In the two-copy rank minimization min_X [2r(X)+|E\X|], for a nonconstant query e a minimizing X shows that deletion lowers the bound by one if e is outside X, and contraction lowers it by one if e is in X. This proves the adaptive upper bound by induction. On bipartite graphs the Hall-cut necessity follows by separately realizing the traces S intersected with each shore and retaining only the positive-incident edges; the two restricted matchings are vertex-disjoint. Thus the path has dimension floor((n-1)/2), and its zero branch gives the asserted cycle upper bound. The frozen verifier and logged n=3..11 counts were inspected as finite corroboration, not executed or used for the all-order conclusion.
